$roomId..write: auth != null && newData.exists() && ((!data.exists() && newData.child('hostUid').val() === auth.uid && newData.child('status').val() === 'lobby' && newData.child('version').val() === 1) || data.child('hostUid').val() === auth.uid)

settings..validate: newData.hasChildren(['stack','sb','bb']) && newData.child('stack').isNumber() && newData.child('sb').isNumber() && newData.child('bb').isNumber() && newData.child('stack').val() % 1 === 0 && newData.child('sb').val() % 1 === 0 && newData.child('bb').val() % 1 === 0 && newData.child('sb').val() > 0 && newData.child('bb').val() > newData.child('sb').val() && newData.child('bb').val() <= newData.child('stack').val() && newData.child('stack').val() <= 1000000000

$uid..validate: newData.hasChildren(['uid','name','host','ready']) && newData.child('uid').val() === $uid && newData.child('name').isString() && newData.child('name').val().length >= 2 && newData.child('name').val().length <= 24 && newData.child('ready').isBoolean() && newData.child('host').val() === ($uid === newData.parent().parent().child('hostUid').val()) && (!newData.child('seat').exists() || (newData.child('seat').isNumber() && newData.child('seat').val() % 1 === 0 && newData.child('seat').val() >= 0 && newData.child('seat').val() <= 8))

$actionId..validate: $actionId.matches(/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{8,100}$/) && newData.hasChildren(['uid','actionId','kind','payload','createdAt']) && newData.child('uid').val() === $uid && newData.child('actionId').val() === $actionId && (newData.child('kind').val() === 'joinRoom' || (newData.child('kind').val() === 'roomCommand' && root.child('poker/v2/rooms').child($roomId).child('members').child($uid).exists())) && newData.child('createdAt').isNumber() && newData.child('createdAt').val() <= now + 1000 && newData.child('createdAt').val() >= now - 25000
